## Checklist
- [ ] Code compiles (`go build`, `npm run build`)
- [ ] Tests pass (`go test ./...`, `npm test` if applicable)
- [ ] **Documentation updated** (see below)
- [ ] No new warnings (`go vet`, `golangci-lint`, `npm run check`)
- [ ] UI strings in `en.ts`/`uk.ts` updated if changed

## Documentation Updates
**Required for:** New features, UI changes, CLI flags, settings, shortcuts, error messages, troubleshooting topics.

- [ ] Updated relevant task/concept/reference topics in `docs/`
- [ ] Updated `README.md` if user-facing change
- [ ] Updated `CHANGELOG.md` (or will be added to next release)
- [ ] Updated `en.ts` and `uk.ts` for new UI strings
- [ ] Verified glossary (`docs/appendix/glossary.md`) for new terms

### Documentation Checklist (ISO 26514 / ASD-STE100)
- [ ] Task topics: Goal, Prerequisites, Numbered steps, Expected result, Recovery
- [ ] Concept topics: Purpose, What it is, Key behaviors, Limitations
- [ ] Reference topics: Exact identifiers, values, defaults, examples
- [ ] Troubleshooting: Symptom, Conditions, Verified causes, Diagnostics, Actions
- [ ] Sentence length: ≤20 words (procedural), ≤25 words (descriptive)
- [ ] Active voice in procedures
- [ ] Glossary terms used consistently
- [ ] UI labels match `en.ts` exactly
- [ ] Abbreviations defined at first use
